title: DTD declaration and attribute value processing
api_or_output: Working internal common-only DtdValueProcessor/helper contract; owned entity replacement and effective-table attribute default normalization

acceptance.description: Implement internal value processing independently of parser/source-stack: decode XML character references in entity declaration values while retaining general references for use-site expansion; normalize attribute defaults only when explicitly applied with a supplied effective general-entity table, preserving CDATA/tokenized whitespace and direct-character-reference semantics. Reject malformed references/illegal scalars/literal less-than in attribute values/undeclared, external or unparsed attribute entities as required; preserve approved internal model/parser/framing signatures. No public stubs or premature default normalization at model publication. Expose a bounded incremental character-reference/value decoding seam for the future parser: every short split, including arbitrarily long leading-zero numeric references, must progress without buffering their raw spelling or borrowing input after return. Caller owns literal delimiters/PE composition/source newline normalization; reference-produced characters must not be normalized again.

Prove authored/pinned character-reference and whitespace/recursive general-reference cases, predefined behavior and distinct reference versus literal origin, effective-table/internal precedence supplied by caller, active-name cycles even with null EntityDepth, exact/one-over expansion/depth/token capacities and cancellation. Helper owns only actual expansion charges/owned output and borrows no input beyond call; grammar owns raw input/distinct retained-name accounting. Use verified unchanged IDtdBudget, no resolver/core/decoder/DOM dependency or external fetch. Test all character-reference/input/output boundaries, decimal/hex overflow and illegal/lone-surrogate scalars, leading-zero numeric state, literal versus reference whitespace and nested entity output, meaningful progress before EOF and exact consumed units. Publish the internal helper/accounting contract before dependent parser starts.

Compile representative common-only helper usage and record exact internal helper contract at known source; focused and cumulative earlier-milestone/API/reference/planning/owned checks plus explicit cold/setup/warm primitive/owned-output allocation and applicable benchmark evidence. Owned result persistence allocations reported honestly; no speedup/zero-allocation/conformance claim from source inspection.
